purpose: Documentation input for P098-011; no runtime configuration or checker implementation.

extraction_rules.task_definition: Markdown tracker row with a complete task ID in its first cell; duplicate definitions refuse.
extraction_rules.legacy_prose_rule: Only an explicit Depends on statement in a task row lacking such a column supplies prerequisite edges; stop at the first period or semicolon terminating that statement. Preserve its exact text/provenance. Other prose never silently becomes an edge.
extraction_rules.boundary_inputs: Non-task owner/solution/schema contracts in dependency cells are retained separately, not expanded into every task of a proposal.
extraction_rules.qualification: An accepted scoped output remains an edge with its qualification; it does not close the whole upstream task.
extraction_rules.normalization: Resolve links to their label; expand same-prefix inclusive numeric ranges and slash shorthand. Full hyphenated suffixes belong to the task ID. A legacy bare numeric ID inherits the current proposal prefix only when unambiguous; current P098 declarations use full IDs.
extraction_rules.counting: Transitive closure including roots; count unique task IDs and unique directed prerequisite pairs within each named scope. Never count view/status projections as tasks or edges.

view_status_rule: Read output status and evidence qualification from canonical trackers. Report complete only for all required applicable outputs; otherwise report the outstanding outputs and their statuses. Never persist a manually edited view status or use a view as a prerequisite.
required_parser_fixtures: P098-008 historical bare 002 resolves to P098-002 only under explicit legacy scope
retired IDs and derived views add no task/edge
